In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of tumor-infiltrating T lymphocytes (T-IL) for adoptive T-cell therapy of cancer.
the expansion of TIL from patients with melanoma.
the development of novel methods of enhancing TIL expansion, phenotype, and function for use in the adoptive immunotherapy of melanoma.

4-1BBL co-stimulation during the TIL REP can enhance the generation of CD8+ effectors for adoptive T-cell therapy of melanoma.
